hero_subtext: I build attention-grabbing thumbnails, editorial photo manipulations, and print-ready poster work for creators and brands who need to stand out in the feed.
contact_text: Reach out and let's talk about your next thumbnail, poster, or photo manipulation project.
about_text: I'm Hemoh, a graphic designer focused on thumbnail design, photo manipulation, and poster work. I help creators and brands turn ideas into visuals that stop the scroll and hold attention. Every project starts with the story you're trying to tell — the design comes after.
